apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet card skins, passcode themes and wallpapers
apps.localizedDescription: Customize Apple Wallet card artwork, lock screen passcode dialers and PosterBoard wallpapers directly on device, without a jailbreak. Requires iOS 27 or newer, LocalDevVPN running in loopback mode, and Developer Mode pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

本次更新重点优化手机端打开番剧详情和返回的体验，新增本地字体导入，并更新四个内置播放源。

### 界面与交互

- **优化番剧详情转场。** 点击卡片后，圆角小窗口从封面位置逐渐铺满全屏，返回时收回卡片。适配 Android 预测性返回和 iOS 侧滑返回手势。
- **支持导入自定义字体。** 在「设置 → 外观 → 导入字体」选择本地 `.ttf` 或 `.otf` 文件，重启应用后会恢复已导入的字体。
- **调整移动端底部导航。** 优化拖动切换和随滚动收起、显示的交互。社区发帖按钮随底栏一同收起。

### 性能优化/修复

- 优化 Android 首页触摸采样和海报网格绘制，减轻慢速滚动时的细节抖动。
- 减少封面加载、详情刷新和播放选源时的重复处理。内存紧张时释放部分后台标签页。
- 修复ios和macos异常播放器黑屏的问题。

### 播放

- 修复部分 HLS 视频因上游返回重复响应头而无法正常读取分片的问题。

### 平台兼容

- 统一 Android 各架构安装包的版本号，避免同一版本因架构不同而被识别为不同构建。
- 同步 iOS 和 macOS 的媒体库与播放器渲染插件版本，并更新 Windows 打包流程以兼容六位构建号。

apps.name: Apollo for Reddit - GLASS
apps.subtitle: Apollo-Reborn build with Liquid Glass patch
apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project’s ongoing fixes and enhancements.

These sources are intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

Choose the source variant that matches how you sideload:

• Standard: full app bundle with Apollo’s working extensions plus Apollo-Reborn widgets
• No Extensions: strips app extensions, including widgets, to reduce App ID usage on free Apple IDs
• GLASS: adds the Liquid Glass iOS 26 patch and bundled Liquid Glass icon catalog
• No Extensions + GLASS: combines both options

The extension-bearing builds (Standard and GLASS) register about 7 App IDs, one per bundled app extension. A free Apple ID can register 10 App IDs per 7 days, so a clean single install fits, but it is easy to exceed if you install under more than one bundle ID, reinstall within the same week, or sideload other extension-bearing apps. If an install fails with an App ID error, use a No Extensions build (1 App ID) or wait for older App IDs to expire. A paid Apple Developer account has a much higher cap.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

### Features

- Add a **Subreddit Switcher** choice of **Classic** or **Modern** under Interface → Display & Navigation: Classic brings back Apollo's original Favorites popup for title taps and Posts tab holds, and Modern keeps the search sheet (#1604: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Classic is the default on regular iPhones, so updating from 4.0.x brings the popup back; Modern is the default on iPhone Duo
  - Modern now opens with the keyboard up and starts loading your pick right away, and on the iPhone Duo holding the Posts tab opens the switcher from the side rail and when unfolded
- Add **Jump Button Navigation** so the comment jump button can step through comments posted since your last visit instead of top-level threads; press and hold to go back one (#1506: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Choose Threads (default) or New Comments under Settings → General below Jump Button Position, or from a post's ••• menu; the button shows a NEW label in that mode
- Add **Tint Tab Bar Icons** to give unselected tab icons a muted shade of your theme's accent, on the classic and Liquid Glass tab bars and the iPhone Duo side rail (#1684: @IllIIllIllIllII, @AcornElf)
  - Add **Accent Navigation Buttons** on Liquid Glass to draw Back, toolbar and menu buttons in your theme's accent; titles stay neutral
  - Both are off by default under Settings → Appearance → Theme Manager → Options
- Add **Unread Badges** under Interface to show the Inbox's unread count as a small dot on the tab bar and on the Inbox's Notifications and Chat tabs, and to color unread badges with your theme's accent instead of red (#1680: @icpryde, @AcornElf)
  - Compact Dot on Tab Bar, Compact Dot in Inbox (shown while modern Chat is on) and Theme Color are each off by default
- Show **Hidden & Deleted** in Apollo's own post and comment lists, so results follow your post size, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus, and open their threads like anywhere else (#1485: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Items keep their Hidden, Removed or Deleted label, removed posts keep their saved title and media, and the Posts tab has its own Compact Posts / Large Thumbnails button
- Add a **Spelling** setting under Interface → Display & Navigation: Apollo Reborn's screens now use American spelling to match Apollo, and choosing British changes the whole app's spelling to British (#1648: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Posts, comments, usernames and subreddit names keep the spelling they were written with
- Add **All+** to blend NSFW posts back into r/all by Reddit's own hot ranking, the way old Reddit's r/all showed them (#1472: @nnastasi)
  - Off by default: turn on Show NSFW in r/all under Posts & Feeds → All+; it applies to the Hot, Best and Rising sorts, and an optional NSFW boost slider moves them higher
- Make swipes on the open **iPhone Duo** follow your finger: Back within a pane, closing a thread, opening and closing the subreddit list and leaving a profile, with a forward swipe to bring a closed thread or profile back (#1656: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - With **Disable Left Swipes** on, swipe right anywhere in a pane to go Back, folded or unfolded, while galleries and carousels keep their own swipes (#1476: @nnastasi)
  - Turning Split View on or off no longer squashes post and comment text or makes the title bar jump, and sideways drags no longer open posts or start the text loupe
- Add a **draggable divider** between the feed and thread in the open iPhone Duo's landscape split view: hold the grip and drag to resize, and Apollo remembers your width (#1672: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - It snaps near ⅓, 40%, 50% and 60%; double-tap the grip to return to 50/50
- Use the **Focused feed** layout in open portrait on the iPhone Duo too, and switch layouts from feeds and threads opened in Inbox, Account and Search (#1682, #1652: @IllIIllIllIllII)

versions.localizedDescription:
# DukeX v1.0.2 - Expanding the Xbox Experience

DukeX v1.0.2 is our biggest step yet toward preserving the full original Xbox
experience, not just the games. This release introduces the first native macOS
build, expands XB.Live integration, and brings richer community features to both
iOS and macOS.

## What's New

- Native macOS release: DukeX is now available as a Mac Catalyst desktop build
  packaged with a nested Xemu fork, pairing desktop Xemu compatibility with the
  DukeX interface.
- XB.Live Rich Presence and playtime tracking: friends can see what you are
  playing while DukeX tracks supported playtime sessions.
- XB.Live messaging: threaded conversations, friend messaging, unread
  indicators, supported game invites, and existing Xbox inbox support now live
  inside DukeX.
- XB.Live social expansion: friend requests, friend management, online presence,
  and deeper community integration are available from the Profile experience.
- Activity Feed: XB.Live news, friend online status, friend achievement unlocks,
  and community updates now appear in a continuously refreshed timeline.
- Controller Landscape Mode: on iOS, compatible controllers can switch DukeX
  into a controller-first browsing and launch experience.
- Expanded AirPlay and external display support: big-screen play is more
  reliable across supported display configurations.

## Improvements

- Improved achievements with Games, Apps, and Cores grouping plus updated
  artwork handling for XB.Live Core, DukeX Core, and special test titles.
- Improved game tile spacing and cover handling across iOS and macOS.
- Improved XB.Live cloud-save sync metadata with console identity v2,
  content-hash dedupe, and server-assisted cross-console restore handling.
- Fixed achievement progress rounding so time-based achievements do not show
  100% before they are actually complete.

## Availability

- iOS: install `DukeX.v1.0.2.ipa` through StikStore, SideStore, or another
  supported sideloading workflow.
- macOS: install `DukeX.macOS.v1.0.2.dmg` by dragging DukeX to Applications.
- Hardware requirements on iOS remain Apple A14 Bionic or Apple M1 hardware or
  newer.
- iOS 16.0 or later is supported, with iOS 16 support remaining experimental.

## Important

DukeX does not include Xbox system files, game images, BIOS files, copyrighted
content, signing certificates, or user games. Users must provide their own
legally obtained files. DukeX is intended for legitimate emulation,
preservation, testing, and personal library use.

## What's new?

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

versions.localizedDescription:
# Iridium 0.2.0

Download your Steam games directly in Iridium, manage repairs and updates, and try the updated Windows runtime. Game support remains experimental.

## Download

**[Download Iridium (.ipa)](https://github.com/intraducine/iridium/releases/download/v0.2.0/Iridium-unsigned.ipa)**

Requires **iOS or iPadOS 18+**, JIT, and games you own. You only need the IPA to install; supply your own game files or download owned games from Steam.

## Install

1. Sign and install the IPA and helper with a compatible sideloading tool, or import it into LiveContainer using its supported JIT setup.
2. Open Iridium and configure JIT in **Launch Support**.
3. Open **Downloads → Steam** to sign in and queue a game, or use **Add Game** to import a game folder. Choose its executable, add it to your library, then press **Play**.

For standalone installation, preserve `com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit=true` in both Iridium's final app signature and provisioning profile. The anonymous ad-hoc carrier alone grants no installation or memory rights. In LiveContainer, the container process's signature, profile, and JIT setup determine effective rights; importing the guest IPA does not grant them. Both routes still need device validation.

Back up your saves before updating. Update the existing app or LiveContainer entry without deleting its data. Steam repairs and updates keep older installations; saves stored inside an older game folder may need to be copied manually to the new one. Keep that older folder until you have checked your saves.

## What's new

- **Steam downloads in the app.** Sign in with a password or QR code, with Steam Guard support, browse your library, and choose download language, unprotected branch, 32/64-bit files, and owned DLC.
- **A download queue with verification and repair.** Pause, resume, retry, and prioritize downloads. Check for updates or repair downloaded files while keeping the previous installation.
- **Clearer storage warnings.** Download checks use the space available to Iridium and account for verified partial files. **Download Anyway** can bypass an estimated-space warning for one attempt; file verification and real out-of-space errors remain enforced.
- **Updated Windows runtime.** Includes 32-bit WoW64 support and D3D9/D3D12 updates. Support still varies by game and device.
- **Game prerequisite installers.** Run supported setup steps included with a game, or choose **Game Options → Run Installer** for an EXE or MSI installer you provide. Some installers need interaction. Closing the player requests cancellation; Iridium keeps observing the runtime's exit and reports when a restart is required.
- **Reduced duplicate runtime data.** Identical Windows runtime files share one packaged copy. The main app's anonymous ad-hoc signature carries only the increased-memory-limit request; helpers remain unsigned until you sign them.

## Known issues

- Physical-device compatibility for these changes has not been established. Some games may fail to launch or have graphics, video, audio, input, save, or shutdown problems. Skyrim speech and mouse attack issues remain unverified.
- Keep Iridium open while downloading. Downloads pause when the app goes into the background and need to be resumed. Real-account downloads and recovery after Wi-Fi or network loss still need device testing.
- Steam Cloud, Workshop, Steam Families library discovery, password-protected branches, and desktop Steam services are not included. Games that require Steamworks/DRM, anti-cheat, or other unsupported runtime features may not launch after downloading.
- Updates keep older game copies and need extra storage. **Download Anyway** does not create free space; exhausting device storage can also prevent other apps from saving.
- JIT and available memory depend on your device and signing setup; LiveContainer and standalone results can differ. Built-in JIT requires standalone Iridium, debugging permission, a valid pairing file, and LocalDevVPN. Hosted Iridium uses external JIT. Recipient signing, LiveContainer hosting, and game prerequisite success still need device testing.

<details>
<summary>Source code, licenses, and build details</summary>

## Source and licenses

The other release files are for source access, rebuilding, and download verification:

- Download both `Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz.part01` and `.part02` for the complete matching source package.
- `Iridium-source-guide.zip` contains license notices, source records, and build/relink instructions.
- `SHA256SUMS` verifies the IPA, both source parts, and the source guide.

Download all five release files into one folder, then run:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
cat Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz.part01 Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz.part02 > Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz
unzip Iridium-source-guide.zip
shasum -a 256 -c Iridium-source-guide/ASSEMBLED-SHA256SUMS
```

The source guide includes the assembled archive's checksum and rebuild instructions. Keep the matching source and guide beside the IPA at this versioned release URL. GitHub's automatic repository ZIP does not contain all required dependency sources.

Source commit: b7e24f9fb4dd17f5d940c4763123f2b00d0e121f
Build run: https://github.com/intraducine/iridium/actions/runs/37142663989

App and helper version: **0.2.0 (115.1)**, minimum iOS **18.0**, confirmed in the actual delivered Info.plist files. The IPA is **399,916,792 bytes**; SHA-256 `1934922a1fcf1509e305a29d6f0d26579a4318ba95dfcf5b406d5e38f88c9763`.

Source checks, Steam native/simulator checks, the full app build, and final binary/package checks passed. Independent IPA inspection confirmed the exact anonymous XML/DER entitlement carrier with no CMS payload or team identity, eight unsigned non-main native binaries, strict bundle verification, runtime hashes, and ZIP modes and symlinks. Unchanged runtime component outputs were reused after provenance checks. These checks do not establish real-account login, owned-game downloads, game compatibility, recipient signing, or physical-device behavior.

Apple compiler-runtime notice uncertainty and unsigned-IPA contractual authorization remain documented risks. Retain the license guide in `Iridium-source-guide.zip`.

</details>

apps.name: LiveContainer+SideStore
apps.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them!
apps.localizedDescription: An app launcher that runs iOS apps without actually installing them. This build of LiveContainer comes with a built-in SideStore for refreshing your apps.

versions.localizedDescription:
# LiveContainer 3.8.0

> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore (`LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa`), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details.

# New Features

## Storage Management

- Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
- Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
- Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.

## Multiple LiveContainers
- Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)

## Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357)

## Multitasking

- Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208)
- Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250)
- Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
- URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows.

## JIT
- Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler.

## TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN

# Improvements
- Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194)
- IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
- Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
- Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
- Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
- Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388)
- Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417)

# Bug Fixes

- Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339)
- Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209)
- Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239)
- Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368)
- Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347)
- Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386)
- Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430)
- Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329)
- Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870)
- Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (#1394, #1417, #1416)
- Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (#1415)

# Localization

- Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS

# Credits

Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN.

Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows PC games on your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Madeira runs unmodified x86-64 Windows PC games inside a single jailed iOS app: FEX-Emu translates the game's x86 code to ARM64 as it runs, Wine 11.4 built for ARM64EC provides Windows itself, and DXMT plus Madeira's own Direct3D 12 runtime draw Direct3D 9, 10, 11 and 12 through Metal. Games come with a library, Steam sign-in and installs, controller and touch controls, and keyboard, mouse and trackpad input. Requires an iPhone on iOS 26 or later with JIT enabled through StikDebug.

versions.localizedDescription:
### New
- **More stores.** Madeira has a new **GOG** section: sign in with GOG's own login page, see your library, download and update games with the DLC you own, verify and repair them, and play with Galaxy achievements and stats (Madeira stands in for GOG Galaxy). A new **EA app** section: sign in, see your library and download games without the EA app. A new **itch.io** store shows your itch.io games and free games, and downloads and installs them, .7z archives included. **Epic Games** now handles game downloads and cloud saves together.
- **Store tabs.** With more than one store on the library page, a row of tabs at the top (All, Steam, Other, GOG, itch.io, Epic, EA) shows one store at a time. All is the page as before; the tab you pick is remembered.
- **Steam:**
  - DLC downloads with the game, with a switch per DLC
  - beta branches, with beta codes
  - a Workshop page per game
  - achievements
  - choosing the game's language
  - downloading from a PC on the same network
  - faster repairs
  - a switch that turns Steam Cloud off
- **A redesigned library.** Game details pages, a starting screen, and Settings split into pages. You can also turn on a zoomable grid in Settings › Appearance › New library grid.
- **Recommended settings** for many games, with Reset to Recommended. Share Setup sends a game's setup to someone else.
- **Get Help from Claude** on a game's page shares a fixes guide together with your log and config.
- **Translations:** German, Spanish, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian.
- **External drives**, save backups and Home Screen shortcuts.
- **Games and downloads keep running** when you leave Madeira.
- **Wine Mono and Wine Gecko** download for you, without Wine's download windows.
- **Graphics:**
  - MetalFX upscaling per game
  - experimental frame generation
  - a per-game picker for the graphics card the game sees
  - FPS limits, including 40 FPS on 120 Hz screens
  - an optional thermal frame cap
- **The performance overlay** has a Column layout that you can drag anywhere on the screen.
- **Controllers and touch controls:**
  - rumble, adaptive triggers and the lightbar on real controllers
  - an optional DualSense / DirectInput mode
  - gyro aim and turbo
  - touch control gesture zones
  - a size slider per touch control, and the editor's panels close when you tap outside them
  - a **Button style** for touch controls: Glass (Liquid Glass) or Solid (plain opaque buttons), in the in-game menu and in Settings › Appearance
- **On iPad:** Command-V pastes into games, and the mouse wheel scrolls.
- **On iPhone:** a Bluetooth or USB mouse works with AssistiveTouch on; mouse-look no longer stops at the screen edges.
- **JIT:** Madeira offers StikDebug when the built-in helper is not available.

### Fixed
- **Native D3D12:** many fixes, including DXIL tessellation, shader caching and faster pipeline builds.
- **Memory and JIT:** many fixes, so large 64-bit and 32-bit games crash less often.
- **Per-game AVX / AVX2**, for games that quit with c000001d.
- **Steam CEG games** can start through Madeira Dock.
- **Launchers that offered to install a game that was already installed:** Madeira Dock now writes the Registry values from a game's install scripts before the start, as Steam's desktop client does.
- **Rockstar Games Launcher / Social Club 2.4.0.296** (the update of 3 November) loads its pages again.
- **The touch controls' Opacity slider** now fades the buttons on iOS 26; it only faded their labels before.
- **Game pills:** the 32-bit / 64-bit and DirectX pills under each game are gone, because they were often wrong. The size pill stays.

### Known issues
- Some Steam games with CEG copy protection still stop with "Madeira Dock stopped" on first start.
- The GOG and EA app sections are new. Please send a log if something goes wrong.

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**. In-app pairing and the Madeira JIT shortcut need iOS 27.
- If your sideloader asks whether to keep app extensions, keep them: Madeira's in-app JIT runs in one.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to everyone who sent pull requests, logs and test results since 0.1.3.

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs: the charger's real watts, how much of that reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and every temperature sensor in the phone. No network code — nothing it reads leaves your phone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **温度可以显示为华氏度。** 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
- **充电预估。** 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
- **显示版本号。** 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
- **iPad 布局。** iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
- **iPad 热力图。** 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

## 修复

- 发热：CPU 簇（`pACC`、`eACC`）和图像处理器（`ISP`）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 `FrontCameraDie`、`BCMLBSkin` 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
- 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

## 注意

- iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份**充电时**导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
- 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

---

## Improvements

- **Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit.** Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
- **Charge forecast.** While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
- **Version number.** Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
- **iPad layout.** On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
- **iPad heat map.** On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

## Fixes

- Thermal: the CPU-cluster (`pACC`, `eACC`) and image-processor (`ISP`) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as `FrontCameraDie` and `BCMLBSkin` were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
- Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

## Notes

- The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken **while charging**. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
- The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

versions.localizedDescription:
# RewindBox 0.0.11 — Build 721

Everything since RewindBox 0.0.10 (Build 559), brought together in one update.

## 🎮 PlayStation 3 — RPCS3

- **Assassin’s Creed:** audio mixing corrections prevent audio periods from being discarded during waits.
- Reduced redundant rendering interruptions and repeated graphics work, including changes to **Vulkan/MoltenVK**.
- Improved texture caching to reuse more previously calculated results.
- **Black Ops II:** corrections to SPU synchronization, memory reservations and waits involved in stalls.
- **Black Ops II:** earlier submission of pending occlusion results, with a separate bounded budget, targets waits on the game’s main CPU threads.
- Corrected short active-wait timing on iPhones with a 1 GHz system counter and adjusted the BO2 writer-lock wait path.

apps.localizedDescription: Boots a real arm64 macOS Ventura guest on iPhone through Apple's own chain (AVPBooter, iBoot and XNU) on QEMU's apple-vm machine, with the GPU drawn through Metal by reims-vgpu. versions.localizedDescription:
Orchard for iPhone 0.2: a faster emulator and a faster Metal path, plus a fix for guests that end up in Recovery.

Setup and settings: [README](https://github.com/MakrSas/orchard-ios#readme).

## Faster

On an iPhone 15 (A16), light scenes now reach 30–40 frames a second. Dragging a window runs at 10–15 frames a second (in 0.1 it dropped to around 7 once the Dock and menu bar were up).

- **CPU (QEMU TCG)**
  - The jump cache is bigger and better hashed, and keeps each process's blocks across context switches. Block-lookup misses fell from ~15% to ~3%.
  - Changing ASID flushes only the user half of the TLB.
  - The PMU is off, and fewer system-register writes end a translation block or flush the TLB.
- **Fast pointer authentication** (on by default, in Settings → Machine → Processor). The guest still sees PAC, but no signature is computed. That was 10–15% of the emulator's time. Turn it off if macOS stops booting.
- **Metal path (reims-vgpu)**
  - A guest render pass stays on the GPU as one Metal pass, instead of a GPU round trip, a full-frame readback and a re-upload for every draw.
  - Draw buffers come from a shared ring.
  - Shader keys hash faster.
  - Stores write back only the drawn area, with a NEON channel swap straight into guest pages.
- **Tip:** 960×540 at 30 Hz is the sweet spot. In the guest, Reduce transparency helps dragging windows.

## Fixed

- **Guest stuck in Recovery with no disk.** This was macOS installing an automatic update, which cannot complete on this machine. Turn automatic updates off first thing; the README has the settings and the Terminal commands.
- **Disk safety.** The disk is flushed when the app goes to the background and on Shut Down, and the log records guest flushes and I/O errors.

## Also since 0.1

- Sound (experimental, Settings → Machine → Sound).
- A shared folder: Files → Orchard → Shared, mounted in the guest at `http://10.0.2.2:8080`.
- Internet in the guest works.

## You need

- iOS 16 or later, tested on an iPhone 15 with iOS 27, and a phone with 6 GB of memory or more.
- A signing tool that adds the increased memory limit capability, and JIT (such as StikDebug).
- A macOS 13 VM made in UTM on a Mac.

Unofficial, and not affiliated with Apple or ChefKiss. No Apple software is included. Licences: see LICENSE-NOTICE.md.

versions.localizedDescription:
Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

- Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
- To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
- Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
- Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

- Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

- Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
- Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
- Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

- A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
- Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's New

### Added

- **Parametric Equalizer**: Switch between Graphic and Parametric modes with up to 20 custom filters (peak, low shelf, and high shelf; 20 Hz to 20 kHz, +/-24 dB, Q 0.1 to 20), exact numeric entry, and import/export of plain-text AutoEQ-style filter lists (`Preamp` and `Filter` lines). Supported on Desktop, iOS, and Android (via the new playback engine DSP).
- **Personal Home & Dedicated Search Tab**: Home is now always your personal page in both Material and Mornye styles, while Search becomes its own tab/destination opening directly on the extension feed (*Search feed*). On Material Home, the old gray search prompt row was removed so the greeting leads straight into your sections, with a one-time tooltip for existing installs.
- **Recommended for You**: Added a daily cached *"Recommended for you"* shelf on Home suggesting tracks outside your Library based on your most played, recently added, and loved songs.
- **Expanded Home Mixes**: Added **Deep Cuts** and **Year Mix**, daily rotating Artist Mixes and extra genres, balanced variety across mix types, and up to 12 mixes on Home. *On repeat* falls back to Library albums when there is no listening history yet.
- **Home Shows Your Collection & Edit Home**: Home gains a status line under the greeting (songs added since your last visit, downloads in progress), *Finish your collection* (wishlist songs, albums missing songs, recognized songs not in your Library, failed downloads), a Hi-Res shelf while a DAC or exclusive output plays, and a row for a connected Link device. *Edit Home* at the end of the page reorders sections and shows or hides them; *Finish your collection* and *On repeat* start turned off.
- **Pin to Home & Your Own Shortcuts**: Pin albums, playlists, Loved, artists, genres, and folders to Home with a long press in the Library (up to 12), and remove any Home shortcut, the built-in ones included, so the grid can hold only what you picked.
- **Quick Play on Home**: A grid of nine songs from your Library sits under *Shortcuts* (under *Continue listening* in the Mornye style), and one tap plays a song with the other eight queued after it. It leads with the songs you play most and fills up with picks from your Library that change each day, and it can be moved or hidden in *Edit Home*.
- **Recommendations That Learn More**: With *Personalized autoplay* on, *Recommended for you* puts the songs that fit your taste first, Autoplay and mixes place songs you have not played yet through their album, credited artists, and genre, and learning now knows whether you listen on the speaker, wired headphones, Bluetooth, a DAC, a car, or another device. *Settings > Playback* shows how your mixes and recommendations are received once there is enough to measure. Everything stays on your device.
- **Cast to DLNA and FCast Devices**: Besides Google Cast, the app now finds DLNA / UPnP speakers and TVs and FCast receivers on your Wi-Fi network and plays your queue on them with play, pause, seek, and volume. On Android, *Audio Output* gains *Other TVs and speakers* under *Cast to TV*; on iOS and desktop they appear in the same list as Google Cast devices.
- **Update Metadata Over Mornye Link**: Songs you saved from a connected computer or phone can take the tag changes made there since. *Update metadata* on the Link page lists the saved songs that differ, shows each differing tag as the value on this phone and the value on the other device with its own switch, and changes nothing until you confirm.
- **Albums in Mornye Top Picks**: *Top Picks for You* on the Mornye Home now offers albums next to your mixes, each as a tall card whose cover runs on into a soft blur under the title, and the color backgrounds of mix banners now drift gently (they stay still when the system asks for reduced motion and on low-end devices).
- **Recommendations by Genre & Top Picks Page**: The arrow next to *Recommended for you* on Home opens a page with today's suggestions and a shelf for each of your Library's main genres. On the Mornye Home, the arrow next to *Top Picks for You* opens every pick sorted onto its own shelf: *Made for You*, *From your Library*, *New releases*, and the picks of your Home feed extension.
- **Full Profile Page**: Tapping your profile in Settings now opens a complete listener profile with *All time* totals and streaks, *Last 30 days* activity, *Last 12 months*, *Music taste* by genre with a color for each, *Listening habits*, *Time of day*, *Decades*, *Sound quality*, *Top artists/albums/tracks*, and collection counts (profile editing moved to *Edit profile*). *Now playing* shows how far the song has played, and *Listener type* describes you with up to five of 22 traits (such as *Night owl*, *Jazz at heart*, *Throwback lover*, or *Quick skipper*); the two leading ones also show under your name and on the Settings profile row.
- **Share Your Profile**: *Share profile* turns your profile into a story or square image with your photo, your leading listener type in large type, listening time, music taste, top artists and tracks, and sound quality. Choose what shows and the background, then save or share it.
- **Download Focus Mode (External Player)**: Selecting *External player* hides built-in-player-only UI across Home, Library, Profile, and Settings without deleting your queue, listening history, or preferences, focusing the app on downloading and file management.
- **Manual Lyrics Translation Editor & Readable Tags**: Add and edit lyrics translations by hand directly from the player. Saved translations and romanizations now write as readable plain-text tags (`[x-translated:...]`, `[x-romanized:...]`, `[x-translated-words:...]`) in `.mlrc` (`[x-mlrc:2]`) and embedded tags while staying backward-compatible with legacy base64 tags.
- **Customizable Share Lyrics Cards**: Added a *Style* pane with card shapes (**Story** 1080x1920, **Square** 1080x1080, **Wide** 1920x1080), text sizes (**Small / Auto / Large**), alignment options, and a **Save** button to export as PNG without storage permissions.
- **Share a Song's Name or Link**: *Share* on a song now offers **Share name** and **Share link**. Share link looks the song up on your installed extensions and shares its link on the service you pick.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Per-category settings for sort and filters** to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with **Remind later** and **Ignore** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Offset double spreads** to the paged reader for spreads that start on an odd page (@PainTownblue)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Made long strip taps and keys scroll by **Scroll distance** instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Keep screen on** to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
- Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with **Show empty categories during search/filtering** to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved **Create registration code** to **Manage users** and added an **Edit** button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Something went wrong** showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fast external SSDs can now be shared with a VM, and disconnecting a drive no longer freezes UTM. On macOS, drives are safely unmounted before they are handed to a VM.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* (macOS) Check out [UTM Games Database](https://db.getutm.app/) to see and report game compatibility for the experimental 3D driver. Re-install the Windows guest tools to get the latest driver.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

* (macOS) Scripting: add snapshots commands to scripting interface (#7832) (thanks @naveenrajm7)
* (macOS) AVF: Better error message when macOS guest version is too high (#7806) (thanks @sigitkusuma)

## Changes (v5.0.4)
* (macOS) Added support for Neptune backend in virglrenderer for DirectX support
* Localization: Updated German (thanks @Benjamin123-tech)
* Scripting: new reload config and VLAN commands (#7710, #7711) (thanks @GregOriol)
* SPICE: Fixed various bugs in renderer that leads to performance and tearing issues
* SPICE: Fixed a memory leak that could result in large amount of memory use by UTM
* Updated USB icon (#7718) (thanks @tan9)
* Fixed crash in UTMRegistry and memory leak in AVF installer (#7701) (thanks @Casey)

## Changes (v5.0.3)
* Fixed regression in GRUB rendering time due to new graphics backend
* Fixed Vulkan issues on latest Wayland
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Home: Confirm delete when using swipe left (#3086)
* Home: Prevent duplicate VMs from appearing (#7533) (thanks @DevSecTim)
* AVF: Fixed CPU spike and mic loss due to two audio devices (thanks @matapo)
* Scripting: Added ability to get IP address from AVF machines (#7643) (thanks @hellcastter)
* Scripting: Fixed "update registry" for AVM backend (#7664) (thanks @EkkoG)
* Scripting: Improve USB device matching logic (thanks @TronickDev)

## Changes (v5.0.2)
* Environment variables are now logged when debug log is enabled
* Fixed a regression in GL acceleration where desktop might not render correctly (#7626)
* Added geometry shaders support to MoltenVK to enable DXVK (thanks @Anducalliew433) (#7575)
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where EAGL backend boots into a black screen (#7587)
* (iOS) Fixed a crash on iOS 15 due to incompatible symbols (#7593)
* (iOS) Fixed verbose logging for graphics backend
* (iOS) Fixed a crash when GL is enabled due to missing support for glDrawElementsInstancedBaseVertex (#7596)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue when after resizing a window if the guest outputs a different resolution size, the wrong texture resolution is used leading to misaligned cursor and warped graphics (#5781)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where the window resizes to 0x0 when native scaling is enabled

## Changes (v5.0.1)
* CocoaSpice: Reworked Metal renderer to be faster and have lower latency
* Fixed an issue where a BIOS file with a comma in the filename will fail to load
* Default FPS will now be the maximum refresh rate of the display on macOS and iPadOS (iPhone with ProMotion will still have 60Hz as the default rate but can be overridden to 120Hz through settings)
* (macOS) Fixed issue causing `HV_UNSUPPORTED` on startup with Vulkan enabled (#7579)
* (iOS) Fixed resolution issue on external displays (#6040)
* (iOS) Pinch to zoom will turn off automatically updating zoom from the guest (until reset with the resize button)
* (iOS) Fixed external display menu not updating
* (iOS) Fixed incorrect scale on external displays and connecting an external display will now automatically scale to fit
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where powering off the VM will show the home screen but not terminate UTM in the background

## Changes (v5.0.0)
* Add Venus support for Vulkan (#4551)
* Add Apple Core OpenGL support for OpenGL 4.1 (#4285) (thanks @startergo)

## Issues
Please check the full list on [Github](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/issues) and help report any bug you find that is not listed.

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |
| UTM-HV.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (TrollStore) | TrollStore | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM-SE.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, enterprise signing, etc | No | No | No |
| UTM-Remote.ipa | Remote client | Any | No | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad or newer.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

### Verification (macOS)

The macOS release (`UTM.dmg`) is notarized by Apple. To verify the download, run `xcrun stapler validate UTM.dmg`. To verify the install, run `spctl -a -vv /Applications/UTM.app` and check that it is notarized and signed by `Turing Software, LLC (WDNLXAD4W8)`. This needs a network connection, so it cannot run from a sandbox that blocks outgoing connections.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

versions.localizedDescription:
### 正式发布与鸿蒙下载

- 发布 `1.18.5+254`，鸿蒙与 Android 手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux 从同一正式标签重新构建，统一在 GitHub Releases 提供安装包；鸿蒙取消 Beta 分类，用户可从公开发布页直接取得 HAP，应用内稳定更新检查可识别同版本的 HAP 和 manifest。
- 鸿蒙采用 `distribution: bundled`、`channel: harmonyos` 与可选真机报告，HAP、来源 manifest 和 SHA-256 随 Release 长期提供，四种语言 README 与安装指南同步统一下载入口。保持现有包名、桌面名称及递增构建号，覆盖升级仍需沿用用户原签名密钥。
- 构建、源码、版本、原生库及原始包摘要核验仍为发布前置条件；HAP 继续如实记录 `signed: false`、`runtime_verified: false` 和已知平台能力限制。缺少真机报告不阻止发布，主动提供的无效或失败报告仍会被拒绝；历史标签读取原提交的分发、渠道和验收策略。

### 新增语言

- 新增德语和日语各 1067 条界面翻译，覆盖设置、阅读器、收藏、导入导出、备份恢复和错误提示；语言设置、系统语言匹配、Flutter 组件及 JS `APP.locale` 同步支持 `de_DE`、`ja_JP`，德语不同地区与日语无地区设置均能识别，保留已有语言选择和系统默认策略。
- 补充 Apple 平台支持语言声明，日语桌面显示优先使用日文字体；语言菜单的「系统」随界面语言翻译，德日继续保留英文未知文案回退和第三方标签原文，新增实际资源、语言切换以及真实字体下的手机／横屏／桌面与两倍字号设置、菜单、覆盖确认回归。
- 设置选择器限制长选项的占宽，为标题保留空间；确认窗口的长标题支持换行，操作按钮在空间不足时改为纵向排列，避免德语、日语及大字号下布局失败、省略关键标题或挤出确认操作。
- GitHub 全平台正式构建和手动构建在实际安装包中核对翻译词典与来源提交一致，避免漏打包或携带旧版译文；继续使用指定 commit 的工作流产物验证新增语言。

### 语言与翻译修复

- 补齐下载备份覆盖本地修改确认提示的繁体翻译，以及漫画源更新取消提示的简繁翻译；润色阅读器横／竖屏图片数量的英文文案并统一中文括号。
- 将语言选项、持久化标识、Flutter 支持列表和翻译标识集中维护，保留现有简／繁／英文选择及系统语言匹配行为；JS 的 `APP.locale` 在英文下返回约定的 `en_US`，修复原先的 `en_null`，补齐 Flutter 组件本地化代理。
- 启动时载入简繁内置标签词库，查找按当前语言选择，显式切换和系统语言变化立即生效；避免继续使用启动时的旧词库，并保留英文原标签及未知标签回退。
- 文案参数按完整名称替换所有出现位置，避免短参数名替换其他名称的前缀或将参数值再次当作文案参数处理；未知参数继续保留原文。

### 应用启动诊断

- Windows 启动记录细化到 COM、工程与参数准备、实例检查、窗口类、显示器／DPI、窗口、引擎和插件阶段，补充应用版本、系统架构与 CPU 指令能力；主线程异常通过预先准备的句柄记录原始异常代码、模块文件名和相对偏移，捕获边界与 C++ 对象生命周期隔离，保留原异常传播及 Windows 错误报告，并验证日志轮转、不可写时的行为及真实安装包启动记录。用于继续定位 #190 的原设备启动失败，尚未确认原始兼容故障已修复。

### 阅读器修复

- 连续／瀑布流阅读在图片旁的空白区域右键保存或复制时，按当前可见图片行确定原图，复用活动滚动视口的几何与来源校验，保留缩放、平移、重复图片及跨章节的实际页码和章节归属；章节分隔和阅读区域外不选择图片，避免返回「没有图片」或选中隐藏预加载页面（#193）。

### 开发维护

- 阅读器保存失败后恢复悬浮章节导航的回归复用受控帧与真实 I/O 推进，等待退出处理完成后再验证恢复结果，修复鸿蒙 SDK 宿主测试中直接等待退出 Future 可能停滞的问题；保留保存期间禁止导航及失败后可重试的实际行为验证。
- 鸿蒙真机验收报告改为显式 `optional` 策略，随版正式版和候选版均可在缺报告时发布或恢复草稿；已附报告仍核对维护者权限、准确 HAP、源码、版本、摘要和测试结果。继续强制包体与原生库核验，保留未签名和未完成真机验收标记，历史 `required`／`stable_required` 标签仍按原策略恢复。
- 新增德语和日语完整 README，四份项目说明互相提供语言入口，默认 README 继续使用中文；同步更新翻译贡献、术语与验收说明，赞助名单生成、校验和自动同步覆盖全部四份 README。
- 使用现有独立 Dart 语法分析工具核对翻译，覆盖跨行、相邻拼接、转义、条件及列表中的静态文案，校验词典键集合、重复 JSON 键、空值／类型、占位符名称与次数及静态调用参数；替换原来的正则扫描，保留动态文案的校验边界，补充真实资源加载、语言切换、英文回退、所有漫画源失败枚举提示和 JS 语言标识回归，以及中英文翻译维护说明。
- 将正式安装包核验整理为公共工具，按配置推导手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux x64／ARM64 的完整附件清单；实际解包核对版本、架构、源码资源与原生库声明，用 libarchive 读取现有 DEB 的 zstd 压缩内容，明确验证安装目录、ARM64 字体补丁及 Flutter 字体路径编码，采用兼容 Python 3.10 的流式 SHA-256 生成绑定提交、构建运行号与安装包摘要的回执。
- 发布安装包与平台核验回执的 Actions 保留期统一为 30 天；鸿蒙随版 HAP 的构建产物同步保留 30 天，公开 Release 附件长期保留。
- 完整构建将固定版本 cargo-audit 的最新 RustSec 扫描和实际包核验汇总作为必需门禁，从审计程序自身读取版本并准备完整锁定依赖索引，查询失败保留诊断并阻止发布，安全回执有效期为 24 小时；手动构建共用核验入口，新增不公开的真实草稿上传、下载回读及中断后原包恢复演练，演练后清理仅属于本次运行的草稿。
- 正式发布与恢复支持补传缺失原包及复核已经公开的版本，保留已有附件并阻止摘要冲突；恢复按原提交中的门禁政策检查旧构建，并重新扫描原锁文件。来源、安全与平台核验清单作为发布附件长期保留，各阶段和渠道同步状态分别报告。
- 更新检查的超时回归改用受控时钟，在假 HTTP 请求进入后推进截止时间，继续验证取消与原生收尾的顺序，消除繁忙 CI 运行器上依赖真实 30 毫秒启动窗口的竞态。
- 完善中英文翻译贡献入口，提供新语种需求、校对和维护的提报要求，以及现有简繁术语参考与同提交的词典、组件、手机／桌面和大字号验收清单；首批语种按实际需求和校对能力确定。

### 安全与依赖

- 将 Rhttp 的 `cookie` 锁定版本从 0.18.1 更新至 0.18.3，消除最新完整锁文件扫描发现的 RUSTSEC-2026-0594；该公告涉及 Unix `fork()` 后生成私有加密 Cookie 的 nonce 重复，当前依赖未启用此功能。仅更新该 crate 的版本与校验值，继续核验现有原生平台兼容性。
